snippet.title: Warhammer Survivors Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer Survivors launches on the 10th November 2026 on Steam, GOG, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, and Android and iOS devices.

Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, collect and upgrade iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

PLAY THE DEMO - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669620/Warhammer_Survivors/

💬 Join our Discord - https://discord.com/invite/aurochdigital
🩻 Find out more - https://www.aurochdigital.com/warhammer-survivors
